content.user_title: Design Safer Sent Template Builder Interfaces
content.value_statement: Template builders can drift from Sent contracts and expose unsafe submission flows. This skill guides precise editors, previews, validation, and review controls.
actual_capabilities: Maps editor fields to the Sent v3 template definition contract.
Defines structured variable insertion, renumbering, and sample validation.
Specifies previews and controls for SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS templates.
Guides sandbox validation, draft saving, and explicit provider review submission.
Defines lifecycle handling for known, unknown, delayed, and reordered status updates.
limitations: Does not replace authoritative Sent server validation.
Does not provide executable UI components or implementation code.
Does not support RCS rich cards, carousels, or media attachments.
Requires related skills for copy policy, resource operations, and RCS launch readiness.

use_cases.title: Design a New Template Editor
use_cases.description: Plan fields, validation, previews, and submission controls around the Sent v3 contract.

use_cases.title: Audit Payload Mapping
use_cases.description: Check that interface fields serialize into supported template properties without unsupported top-level values.

use_cases.title: Review Lifecycle Safety
use_cases.description: Evaluate status handling, revision recovery, webhook updates, and explicit provider review confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Basic Editor
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Sent template editor. Identify missing required fields, unsafe save behavior, and unclear validation feedback.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a simple template form

prompt_templates.title: Design Channel Previews
prompt_templates.prompt: Design SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS previews for this template flow. Include supported content, samples, accessibility, and channel-specific constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Variables and Buttons
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit variable insertion, entity mapping, renumbering, button limits, authentication restrictions, and complete channel overrides in this builder.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate the Full Lifecycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this builder from draft creation through provider review. Cover payload mapping, sandbox validation, revisions, webhooks, unknown states, and failure recovery.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced end-to-end product and contract audit

output_examples.input: Review a builder that saves and submits in one action.
output_examples.output: Separate draft saving from review submission. Show a final confirmation with category, language, samples, overrides, buttons, warnings, and external-state impact.

output_examples.input: Assess a variable editor where users type placeholder syntax directly.
output_examples.output: Replace direct placeholder editing with structured insertion. Update placeholders and entity records together, preserve samples, and report unmatched identifiers beside affected fields.

output_examples.input: Plan an RCS template preview with rich cards and SMS fallback.
output_examples.output: Limit the current preview to text and four suggestion chips. Mark rich cards as roadmap-only and keep routing decisions outside the editor.

best_practices: Keep one canonical draft aligned with the Sent definition contract.
Validate locally, then use sandbox validation before saving or submitting.
Preserve drafts, server responses, and revision history across errors and status changes.
anti_patterns: Do not autosubmit templates when users save drafts.
Do not let users edit placeholder syntax separately from variable entities.
Do not present unsupported RCS capabilities as available builder controls.

faq.question: Which channels does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers SMS, WhatsApp, and current Sent RCS template experiences.

faq.question: Does this skill generate production UI code?
faq.answer: No. It provides design, validation, payload mapping, and audit guidance.

faq.question: Can local validation replace server validation?
faq.answer: No. Local checks are advisory, and Sent server validation remains authoritative.

faq.question: Should saving a draft submit it for review?
faq.answer: No. Saving and provider review submission should remain explicit, separate actions.

faq.question: How should unknown status values appear?
faq.answer: Preserve the raw value, show a neutral state, and avoid destructive assumptions.

faq.question: Does the skill support RCS rich cards?
faq.answer: No. Current guidance supports text and up to four suggestion chips.
